faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIIT Dharwad Scientific Administrative Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the Scientific Administrative Assistant position at IIIT Dharwad is September 30, 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to possess a Graduate degree in any discipline to be eligible for the Scientific Administrative Assistant role at IIIT Dharwad.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Scientific Administrative Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Scientific Administrative Assistant post is 50 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the norms of DST, Government of India.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Scientific Administrative Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Scientific Administrative Assistant position will receive a salary of Rs. 21,600 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Scientific Administrative Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Scientific Administrative Assistant position at the Indian Institute of Information Technology Dharwad.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Screening, followed by a Written Test, and finally an Interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application mode for IIIT Dharwad Scientific Administrative Assistant jobs?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is strictly online. Candidates must submit their applications through the official portal.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIIT Dharwad located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Information Technology Dharwad is located in Dharwad, Karnataka.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The job offered for the Scientific Administrative Assistant position is on a contractual basis.
